description: Create a rate alert to monitor a hotel for price drops. The user will be notified by email when the rate drops. Optionally specify dates, or leave them out to monitor any two-night stay.

checkin.description: Optional check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

checkout.description: Optional check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

hotel_id.description: The hotel's Vervotech property ID (from search results).

name: create_rate_alert
